units.source_text: 以前的同堂，如今早就疏远了罗连，避之不及。

en.t: His former fellow parishioners had long since grown distant from Lian and avoided him at every turn.

units.source_text: 以神甫为主，没人怜悯他。

en.t: Beginning with the priest, no one showed him any pity.

units.source_text: 知道这个被破门处置的无耻少年，还有每夜在教堂祷告的信心，

en.t: They knew that this shameless boy, excommunicated from the church, still had the faith to pray in the church every night,

units.source_text: 虽然主的的慈安是无量的，但是仍然觉得他的行为不合适，罗连对此，深觉得痛苦难言。

en.t: and although the Lord's mercy is boundless, they still felt that his conduct was improper, and Lian found this painfully hard to bear.
